{{Quote|Now you'll get a lesson in humanity from Clan Rose!|Reaker}}
'''Reaker''' is a [[non-player character]] [[moogle]] from ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''. Taking the appearance of a typical [[Mog Knight]] and the leader of Clan Rose, she set up a trick in the shape of a girl named '''Mogumi''' to lure [[Montblanc]] to the [[Materiwood]], believing that she and Montblanc would be perfect together.

==Battle==
[[File:FFTAClanRose.png|thumb|left|Reaker and her fellow clan mates.]]
{{Quote|My dearest Montblanc, I think of you always. If we could meet, I would much like to tell you how I feel in person.<br>—Mogumi, Townsgirl|Mission description}}
Reaker appears in "Mission #089: [[A Bride for Montblanc|Moogle Bride]]", where she sets up the trick in form of a townsgirl and wants to give Montblanc a "lesson in humanity". As the leader of Clan Rose, Reaker is the enemy party's boss.

Reaker has four moogle units with her, a [[Black Mage (Tactics Advance)|Black Mage]], a [[Time Mage (Tactics Advance)|Time Mage]], a [[Thief (Tactics Advance)|Thief]], and a [[Juggler (Tactics Advance)|Juggler]], all fellow moogles.

===Equipment===
*'''Weapon:''' Venus Blade
*'''Armor:''' Opal Armor
*'''Shield:''' Opal Shield

==Etymology==
Reaker's Japanese name, "Reika", means "lovely flower". This is related to her clan name, while her alias "Mogumi" is a formation of "Megumi", which means "blessing". Otherwise, the name "Mogumi" might be based on the ''[[Final Fantasy IX]]'' moogle, Mogmi. Another possibility could be it is a play on the Japanese pronunciation of "moogle", which is "Moguri".
